hero.headline:
Book trusted students,
in seconds.
hero.subheadline: From stylists to photographers to home repair — ScheduleMe connects you with vetted local professionals and student service providers on campus. Browse, book, and pay in one place.
hero.trust_line: Free to use · No commitment · Cancel anytime

features.title: Fast requests, zero chasing
features.description: Send one request and see who’s available. No cold calls, no waitlist, no “I’ll call you back.”

features.title: Actually vetted pros
features.description: Campus‑friendly pros with real reviews and visible work. You’ll see the person’s profile before you book.

features.title: Built for campus life
features.description: Find classmates and nearby students offering services — photo, beauty, tutoring, design, and more.

features.title: No hidden fees
features.description: Free for students. Providers only pay when a job is completed, so they’re motivated to show up.

demo_steps.title: Describe it like you'd text a friend
demo_steps.description: "Need a fade before Friday night near campus." That's all you need.

demo_steps.title: We match by keywords
demo_steps.description: Your request is matched to campus pros and nearby providers that fit what you asked for.

demo_steps.title: Book, message, done
demo_steps.description: Pick your pro, book directly, and message them from the app. No phone calls unless you want them.
